_note: 科研時事（站點級，跨科目）。顯示在三科總覽頁。cat 用 bio/chem/phys/math，只影響標籤顏色。越新的排越前。內容必須來自可靠來源並附連結——時事不是常識，寧可少寫也不要編。本檔由 scripts/fetch_news.py 自動抓取泛科學 RSS 產生，可手動補充。

items.t: 科學家表示，一個被遺忘的粒子可能會解釋宇宙存在的原因
items.x: 一種被忽視了數十年的神秘粒子可能是解釋物質為何能在大爆炸中倖存下來、讓恆星、行星和生命得以存在的關鍵。科學家認為，這種被遺忘的中微子重塑了早期宇宙，並可能留下了可偵測到的重力波訊號，有助於解開宇宙最深的奧秘。
items.orig: Scientists say a forgotten particle may explain why the universe exists
items.origX: A mysterious particle overlooked for decades may hold the key to why matter survived the Big Bang, allowing stars, planets, and life to exist. Scientists believe this forgotten neutrino reshaped the early universe and may have left detectable gravitational wave signals that could help unlock the cosmos’s deepest mysteries.

items.t: 科學家將阿基米德螺旋縮小到單一分子的大小
items.x: 受 2000 多年前發明的機器的啟發，科學家們建造了一種突破性的分子馬達，可以利用電力雙向旋轉。更值得注意的是，它的旋轉可以將電導率提高多達 100 倍，有可能改變分子電子學的未來。
items.orig: Scientists shrink Archimedes’ screw to the size of a single molecule
items.origX: Scientists have built a groundbreaking molecular motor that spins in either direction using electricity, inspired by a machine invented more than 2,000 years ago. Even more remarkably, its rotation can boost electrical conductivity by up to 100 times, potentially transforming the future of molecular electronics.

items.t: 人工智慧揭示了一種隱藏的化學捷徑，可以將二氧化碳轉化為燃料
items.x: 科學家利用人工智慧發現了近 10,000 個將二氧化碳轉化為燃料和化學品的化學反應，揭示了傳統模型遺漏的關鍵途徑。這項發現極大地改善了對二氧化碳轉化的預測，並揭示了一種令人驚訝的氫反應，可以激發更高效的催化劑。
items.orig: AI reveals a hidden chemical shortcut that could turn CO2 into fuel
items.origX: Scientists used artificial intelligence to uncover nearly 10,000 chemical reactions involved in transforming carbon dioxide into fuels and chemicals, revealing crucial pathways that traditional models had missed. The discovery dramatically improved predictions of CO2 conversion and uncovered a surprising hydrogen reaction that could inspire more efficient catalysts.

items.t: 科學家可能找到了聚變能源的捷徑
items.x: 普林斯頓等離子體物理實驗室可能已經透過扭轉傳統方法找到了更有效的聚變能途徑：首先加熱等離子體，然後增加其密度。他們的計算可以幫助未來的反應器以少得多的能量實現自我維持聚變，同時避免導致點火更加困難的隱藏問題。
items.orig: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
items.origX: Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory may have found a dramatically more efficient route to fusion energy by reversing the traditional approach: heating plasma first, then increasing its density. Their calculations could help future reactors reach self-sustaining fusion with far less energy while avoiding hidden problems that make ignition harder.

items.t: 埃及的古猿化石可能改寫人類起源的故事
items.x: 在埃及發現的一個 1700 至 1800 萬年前的猿類化石正在挑戰人們長期以來對人類和其他現代猿類祖先最初進化地點的看法。科學家現在懷疑北非和中東，而不是東非，可能是現代猿類進化的搖籃。
items.orig: Ancient ape fossil in Egypt could rewrite the story of human origins
items.origX: A 17- to 18-million-year-old ape fossil discovered in Egypt is challenging long-held beliefs about where the ancestors of humans and other modern apes first evolved. Scientists now suspect that North Africa and the Middle East, rather than East Africa, may have been the cradle of modern ape evolution.

items.t: 科學家發現樹木用來挺直自己的隱藏“肌肉”
items.x: 科學家發現，樹木可以感知自己的形狀，並利用特殊的木材來拉直樹幹，這些木材的作用就像相反的肌肉。這種非凡的能力可以幫助樹木保持其姿態，並可能帶來更強大的森林、更好的木材和更有彈性的作物。
items.orig: Scientists discover the hidden “muscles” trees use to straighten themselves
items.origX: Scientists have discovered that trees can sense their own shape and straighten their trunks using specialized wood that acts like opposing muscles. This remarkable ability helps trees maintain their posture and could lead to stronger forests, better timber, and more resilient crops.

items.t: 科學家粉碎氧核以重建大爆炸中的物質
items.x: 科學家以接近光速的速度碰撞氧原子核，重建了宇宙誕生之初物質的原始狀態。令人驚訝的結果表明，這種奇異物質可以在比之前證明的更小、能量更低的碰撞中形成，挑戰了早期宇宙物理學的已知界限。
items.orig: Scientists smash oxygen nuclei to recreate matter from the Big Bang
items.origX: Scientists have recreated a primordial state of matter from the dawn of the universe by colliding oxygen nuclei at nearly the speed of light. The surprising results show that this exotic substance can form in smaller, lower-energy collisions than previously demonstrated, challenging the known boundaries of early-universe physics.

items.t: 晶體中的微小缺陷揭示了巨大的量子驚喜
items.x: 研究人員解決了一個長期存在的挑戰，即了解鑽石和碳化矽等材料中的微小缺陷在光照下如何表現。他們的新計算方法揭示了碳化矽中一個令人驚訝的重要能量損失機制，而科學家之前卻低估了這個機制。這項發現有助於解釋多年來困擾研究人員的謎團，
items.orig: A tiny defect in a crystal reveals a big quantum surprise
items.origX: Researchers have solved a long-standing challenge in understanding how tiny defects in materials like diamond and silicon carbide behave when exposed to light. Their new computational method revealed a surprisingly important energy-loss mechanism in silicon carbide that scientists had previously underestimated. The finding helps explain a mystery that has puzzled researchers for years and could improve the design of quantum computers and sensors.

items.t: 科學家揭示了隱藏的蛇咬傷危機，每年導致多達 513,000 人死亡
items.x: 一項令人震驚的新研究表明，全世界因毒蛇咬傷而死亡的人數遠遠多於官方統計數字，估計每年有 274,000 至 513,000 人死亡。研究人員發現，每年有多達 700 萬人遭受蛇毒攻擊，而超過 80 萬名倖存者會留下長期殘疾。
items.orig: Scientists reveal a hidden snakebite crisis killing up to 513,000 people a year
items.origX: A startling new study suggests that venomous snakebites are killing far more people worldwide than official statistics indicate, with an estimated 274,000 to 513,000 deaths every year. Researchers found that as many as 7 million people could suffer snake envenoming annually, while more than 800,000 survivors are left with long-term disabilities.
